mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as it uses the current level of FEDFUNDS without requiring a threshold crossing condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals labor market weakness, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.3pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The interaction is non-additive: the effect is stronger when both conditions are met.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03, or the positive return rate is less than 55% in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a strong housing market (HOUST) and high consumer spending (RSAFS) signal robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 thousand persons is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active as it uses the current level of PAYEMS without requiring a threshold crossing condition.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is above 140,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust supply-side expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The interaction effect is non-additive: the positive return effect is amplified when both series are rising.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03, or the positive return rate is less than 55% in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market recovery regimes, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,100 thousand units signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during housing market recovery, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
